title: Add Pixel Forge to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pixel Forge](https://b3b41020.github.io/pixel-forge) to image
- AI image generation studio powered by Pollinations. Users enter a prompt, select a model (Flux, Dreamshaper, Klein, GPT Image 2, Zimage, Nanobanana) and image size, then generate. Built with the Polli

Fixes #14065

gist.headline: Pixels enter the forge
gist.blurb: Pixel Forge joined the garden: a small AI image studio where a prompt, a model, and a canvas size become something visible. Polli brought the sparks and wisely stayed away from the hot bits.
gist.summary: Added Pixel Forge, a Pollinations-powered image generation studio where users can choose Flux, Dreamshaper, Klein, GPT Image 2, Zimage, or Nanobanana along with an image size before generating.
gist.impact: People can now use Pixel Forge as a focused visual workspace for comparing Pollinations image models and turning prompts into images at their chosen dimensions.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Pixel Forge as a cozy little pixel-art workshop: a retro image-generation console with prompt cards, model selector dials, and freshly made pixel pictures emerging from a warm forge-like printer. Polli, wearing tiny safety goggles and a tool belt, adjusts the model dial while code-plants and flowers grow around the workstation, making the studio feel handmade rather than industrial.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art image-generation workshop called Pixel Forge, with a retro CRT console showing a prompt field, chunky model selector dials labeled Flux, Dreamshaper, Klein, GPT Image 2, Zimage, and Nanobanana, and small pixel artworks emerging like warm prints from a friendly forge. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny safety goggles and a tool belt while tuning the console beside code-plants and flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow, emotionally warm.
